**GRAND GROUP CORPORATION - Your Trusted Chemical Solutions Partner**

GRAND GROUP CORPORATION stands as a prominent chemical enterprise strategically located in the thriving commercial hub of Ningbo, Zhejiang Province, China. Headquartered on the 13th floor of the prestigious Pacific Plaza at No. 555 Jingjia Road, our company has established itself as a reliable force in the global chemical industry, leveraging Ningbo's position as one of China's most important port cities and industrial centers.

Since our establishment, GRAND GROUP CORPORATION has dedicated itself to the development, manufacturing, and distribution of high-quality chemical products serving diverse industries worldwide. Our strategic location in Ningbo provides us with exceptional logistics advantages, including proximity to the Ningbo-Zhoushan Port—one of the world's busiest ports—enabling efficient global supply chain management and timely delivery to our international clientele.

Our comprehensive product portfolio encompasses industrial chemicals, specialty chemicals, and chemical intermediates that meet stringent international quality standards. We pride ourselves on combining advanced manufacturing technologies with rigorous quality control systems, ensuring consistent product excellence. GRAND GROUP CORPORATION maintains strong partnerships with clients across Asia, Europe, the Americas, and beyond, built on our commitment to reliability, innovation, and customer satisfaction. Our experienced team of chemical professionals works tirelessly to provide customized solutions that meet the evolving needs of modern industries.
